CHANGELOG updated in EmilyOS: Split the Alpine/RPi image build into a root-less half (packaging/scripts/build-pi-image-rootless.sh, run and verified live) and a much smaller privileged half (sudo-queue/76). Found live: mke2fs -d needs root for Alpine's execute-only bbsuid; cmd/emilyos doesn't cross-compile to linux/arm64 with CGO_ENABLED=0 (fsaclmod is cgo-only). (sess-20260905-0720-ec33e7c5)

⚓ ☃
